Zabrana vozila i pješaka u nacionalnim parkovima, šumama i ranjivim područjima. Coverage: Δ/νση Πολιτικής Προστασίας. The portal shows the English title as "Zakaz ruchu pojazdów i pieszych w parkach narodowych, lasach i na obszarach szczególnie narażonych" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Δ/νση Πολιτικής Προστασίας. Its keywords include Από μετάπτωση, Απαγόρευση κυκλοφορίασ, repository.data.gov.gr. The listing shows 1 download or service links in CSV. The listing shows 2026-02-24 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-gr.
